title: Q-GROW-adaptive-follow-ups: Follow-up questions chosen from the first answer keep people in the interview.
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every product-manager cycle
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/growth.json::"id": "adaptive-follow-ups"
**Prediction:** interview_completion_rate >= 0.5 within 168 h
**Status:** open

Growth experiment on target `interview-completion` (interview_completion_rate target 0.5), knob `interview-questions` in `site/interview.js`: question bank and order. an idea flow that people finish. Ship the change, log the prediction, keep it if the metric moved and revert it if not.
